title: Reliability by Architecture: Agentic Workflows for Validated Multi-Physics Simulation from Natural Language
abstract: arXiv:2611.23473v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Preparing, executing, and validating strongly coupled multi-physics simulations require expert time. Agentic workflows use large language models (LLMs) to coordinate them from natural-language descriptions, but reliability requires checks of physical consistency and fidelity to the problem description. Our agentic harness implements explicit task allocation: LLMs interpret user requests and simulator diagnostics, generate input components not covered by predefined construction rules, and propose repairs, while deterministic routines construct supported components and check inputs, edits, and results. We evaluate CO2-storage problems using the multi-physics simulator GEOS, from compositional flow to flow-poromechanics with frictional fault contact. translated_title: 架构级可靠性：基于自然语言的经验证多物理场模拟智能体工作流
translated_abstract: 准备、执行和验证强耦合多物理场模拟需要专家投入大量时间。智能体工作流利用大语言模型（LLM）根据自然语言描述来协调这些任务，但要保证可靠性，必须对物理一致性以及与问题描述的忠实程度进行检查。我们的智能体框架实现了明确的任务分配：LLM负责解读用户请求和模拟器诊断信息，生成预定义构建规则未覆盖的输入组件，并提出修复方案；而确定性例程则负责构建受支持的组件，并检查输入、编辑和结果。我们使用多物理场模拟器GEOS评估CO2储存问题，涵盖从组分流动到含摩擦断层面接触的流动-孔隙力学问题。在两个流动问题上共80次尝试中，接地机制将结构有效输入的比例从5/20提升至20/20，但只有在完全采用基于规则的输入准备时，接受率才能达到20/20。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种“架构即可靠性”的设计思路，通过LLM与确定性例程之间的明确任务分工，实现了从自然语言描述到经验证的CO2储存多物理场模拟的可靠自动化，将结构有效输入比例从5/20提升至20/20。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a "reliability by architecture" design that explicitly divides tasks between LLMs and deterministic routines, enabling validated automated multi-physics CO2-storage simulation from natural language, raising structurally valid inputs from 5/20 to 20/20.
